title: Charming Music City Condo
description:
Our charming Music City condo, The Loretta, is located minutes from downtown and its a close to walk to The Gulch, Music Row, 12th South and Wedgewood Houston areas. You're a short (safe) walk or cab ride away from some of the best food and shopping in the city.

The space
The condo has everything you need for a comfortable adventure in Music City. Cozy and bright the space is renovated and beautifully decorated with all the amenities you'll need for a home away from home. With two bedrooms the unit is perfect for both a romantic getaway or for a small group of friends.

Guest access
The whole condo is available for your use!
